bidirectional_dependency_evidence: Field experiments report that S. insularis fruit set depends entirely on D. heterosmilacicola; the midge breeds in host male flowers and the study treats the interaction as an obligate brood-site pollination mutualism.
declared_geographic_scope: Ryukyu Archipelago and Taiwan; exact confirmatory frame not yet frozen
known_alternative_partner_boundary: Full-range partner exclusivity and any alternative larval host or alternative effective pollinator must pass a separate adversarial literature review before admission.
